title: OpenCode Converse plugin options
description: Options for the OpenCode Converse plugin. The engine and speech-model locations are fixed under the app state folder and cannot be configured.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema pointer. Ignored by the runtime.

supervisorModel.description: Required before starting a conversation. Model used by the hidden Converse supervisor agent.

workerModel.description: Required before starting a conversation. Model used by the hidden Converse worker agent.

ttsThreads.description: Accepted for compatibility with the settings contract; Phonon manages its own CPU threads, so this currently has no effect.

endpointing.description: How long to wait in silence before treating your turn as finished. responsive: about 0.26 s before the end-of-turn check, 1.9 s hard stop. patient: about 0.64 s and 3 s, for slower or more thoughtful speech.

acknowledgement.description: auto: if the reply has not started speaking about 0.6 s after your turn is sent, say one short neutral cue ("Okay.", "On it.", "Let me check.") that claims nothing. off: stay silent until the reply begins.

echoCancellation.description: on: subtract the engine's own playback from the microphone (WebRTC AEC3) so you can interrupt on speakers; barge-in then needs far less confirmation. off: no echo cancellation and a conservative barge-in guard (about 0.5 s of clear speech); use headphones.

agentChat.description: on: with two or more agents, an agent whose reply starts (or ends, after a comma) with another agent's name hands the floor to that agent, spoken in its own voice. Bounded per user turn: at most 4 agent turns, 90 seconds, and 2 round trips between the same pair; speaking ends it. off: agents only answer you.

agents.description: Named voice agents for this conversation (1 to 4), fixed when the conversation starts. Each agent has its own voice and its own OpenCode session. Say a name first ("Ada, check the build") to address one; with no name the first agent answers. Absent: one agent in the default voice.

name.description: Spoken name; unique (case-insensitive), 2 to 16 ASCII letters. Not a reserved word such as stop, mute, pause, resume, start, attach, detach, user, assistant, everyone, all, or system.

voice.description: One of the four shipped English voices (zoey: bright US female, maeve: British female, easton: US male, preston: deeper US male). Unique per agent. Omitted: the first unused voice in that order.

agent.description: OpenCode primary agent this agent's own session runs as. Checked against the server's selectable agents when the conversation starts. Omitted: the hidden Converse supervisor agent. A custom agent keeps its own permissions; the Converse tools and prompt are still added to this session only.

model.description: Model for this agent's session. Omitted: supervisorModel.

prompt.description: Extra instructions for this agent only.
